tagline.en: VGGT-Omega — a feed-forward geometry transformer that recovers 3D scene structure from images for reconstruction and novel views.
tagline.zh: VGGT-Omega——前馈式几何 Transformer，从图像恢复 3D 场景结构，用于重建与新视角合成。

en: VGGT-Omega is a visual geometry transformer in the VGGT family, distributed on Hugging Face as facebook/VGGT-Omega. It predicts 3D scene structure directly from images in a single feed-forward pass, supporting 3D reconstruction, Gaussian splatting, and novel-view synthesis.

The model works from as little as a single image and outputs geometry you can export as a scene. In WorldFoundry the runtime follows the official scene-export route, emitting a predictions.npz file alongside a GLB scene artifact you can open in standard 3D tools.
Note the checkpoint is released under CC-BY-NC-4.0, so its use is limited to non-commercial purposes.
zh: VGGT-Omega 是 VGGT 系列中的视觉几何 Transformer，在 Hugging Face 上以 facebook/VGGT-Omega 发布。它以单次前馈推理直接从图像预测 3D 场景结构，支持 3D 重建、高斯泼溅与新视角合成。
该模型最少只需一张图即可工作，并输出可导出为场景的几何。在 WorldFoundry 中，运行时遵循官方的场景导出路线，产出 predictions.npz 文件以及可用常见 3D 工具打开的 GLB 场景文件。
注意该 checkpoint 采用 CC-BY-NC-4.0 许可，因此仅限非商业用途。

whenToUse.en: Choose VGGT-Omega for fast, feed-forward 3D geometry recovery from images — reconstruction, splatting, or novel-view synthesis — when you can work within a non-commercial license.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从图像快速前馈恢复 3D 几何（重建、泼溅或新视角合成），且可接受非商业许可时，选择 VGGT-Omega。

notFor.en: The CC-BY-NC-4.0 license rules out commercial use. Weights are staged separately and not bundled in source.
notFor.zh: CC-BY-NC-4.0 许可排除了商业用途。权重需单独准备，不随源码打包。

en: Feed-forward 3D geometry from images, even a single view
Covers reconstruction, Gaussian splatting, and novel-view synthesis
Exports predictions.npz plus a GLB scene artifact
zh: 从图像（乃至单张视图）前馈恢复 3D 几何
覆盖重建、高斯泼溅与新视角合成
导出 predictions.npz 与 GLB 场景文件
